description.zh: 展翅翱翔的流程定义——设置、4 回合循环、回合末目标、终局计分与判胜。行动/触发器的结构化定义在 triggers 组。
description.en: Wingspan flow definition — setup, 4-round loop, end-of-round goals, final scoring, and adjudication. Actions/triggers are defined in the triggers group.

description.zh: 一局完整的<wingspan_setting>：设置 → 4 个回合（每回合玩家行动至可用方块用完，随后回合末计分、刷新鸟盘、传递先手）→ 终局计分与判胜。
description.en: A whole game of <wingspan_setting>: setup → 4 rounds (players act until available cubes are used, then end-of-round scoring, refresh bird tray, pass first player) → final scoring and adjudication.

description.zh: 公共设置与玩家设置。
description.en: Global and player setup.

description.zh: 准备鸟牌库、鸟盘、食物/蛋供应、骰塔、目标板、奖励牌库。
description.en: Prepare the bird deck, bird tray, food/egg supply, birdfeeder, goal board, and bonus deck.

description.zh: 把所有<bird_card>洗匀成<bird_deck>，放在鸟盘旁。
description.en: Shuffle all <bird_card>s into <bird_deck> next to the bird tray.

description.zh: 把所有<food>与<egg>放入公共<ontology::supply>，对所有玩家可见。
description.en: Put all <food> and <egg> into the public supply, visible to all players.

description.zh: 选择<goal_board>使用的面（绿色多数决或蓝色每项 1 分），把 4 块<goal_tile>随机放到目标板空格。
description.en: Choose the active side of the <goal_board> (green majority or blue 1 point each) and randomly place 4 <goal_tile>s in its slots.

description.zh: 把所有<bonus_card>洗匀成<bonus_deck>。
description.en: Shuffle all <bonus_card>s into <bonus_deck>.

description.zh: 每位玩家获得玩家板、8 个行动方块、5 张随机鸟牌、2 张奖励牌、5 个食物（每种 1 个）；保留最多 5 张鸟牌（每保留 1 张弃 1 个食物），保留 1 张奖励牌；然后随机决定先手玩家。
description.en: Each player receives a player mat, 8 action cubes, 5 random bird cards, 2 bonus cards, and 5 food (one of each type); keep up to 5 birds (discard 1 food per kept bird) and keep 1 bonus card; then randomly determine the first player.

description.zh: 每位玩家获得 1 张<player_mat>、8 个<action_cube>、5 张随机<bird_card>、2 张<bonus_card>、5 个<food>（每种 1 个）。
description.en: Each player receives 1 <player_mat>, 8 <action_cube>s, 5 random <bird_card>s, 2 <bonus_card>s, and 5 <food> (one of each type).

description.zh: 从 5 张鸟牌中保留最多 5 张（可少于 5），其余弃掉；每保留 1 张鸟牌必须弃 1 个<food>。玩家可互相查看选择的鸟牌与奖励牌。
description.en: Keep up to 5 of the 5 bird cards (fewer is allowed) and discard the rest; discard 1 <food> for each bird kept. Players may reveal their kept birds and bonus cards to each other.

description.zh: 从 2 张<bonus_card>中保留 1 张，弃掉另一张。
description.en: Keep 1 of the 2 <bonus_card>s and discard the other.

description.zh: 在所有玩家选完鸟牌、食物与奖励牌后，随机决定先手玩家并给予<first_player_marker>。
description.en: After all players have chosen birds, food, and bonus cards, randomly determine the first player and give them the <first_player_marker>.

description.zh: 游戏进行 4 个回合，每回合玩家可用行动方块数递减（8/7/6/5）。
description.en: The game is played over 4 rounds; available action cubes decrease (8/7/6/5).

description.zh: 从起始玩家开始按顺时针轮流行动，每位玩家每次从 4 个行动中选 1 个，直到本回合可用行动方块全部用完。
description.en: Starting with the start player, players take turns clockwise, each turn choosing one of the four actions, until all available action cubes for the round are used.

description.zh: 移除所有行动方块，结算回合末目标，刷新鸟盘，传递先手玩家标记。
description.en: Remove all action cubes, score the end-of-round goal, refresh the bird tray, and pass the first player marker.

description.zh: 从所有玩家板上移除本回合已使用的<action_cube>。
description.en: Remove all used <action_cube>s from every player mat.

description.zh: 第 4 回合结束后，汇总鸟牌分值、奖励牌、回合末目标、鸟蛋、缓存食物、塞入牌，并判胜。
description.en: After round 4, total bird card points, bonus cards, end-of-round goals, eggs, cached food, and tucked cards, then determine the winner.

name.en: All Action Cubes Used This Round

description.zh: 本回合每位玩家都已把其可用数量的行动方块放到行动行上。
description.en: Every player has placed all their available action cubes for this round.

description.zh: 选择 1 张手牌中的<bird_card>，决定放入的栖息地（<forest_habitat>/<grassland_habitat>/<wetland_habitat>，若牌上有多个栖息地符号可选其一）与所在列（第 1 列无蛋费，第 2–3 列 1 蛋，第 4–5 列 2 蛋）。支付食物费（只能用<player_food_supply>中的<food>；<wild_food>可当任意一种；打鸟时 2 个任意食物可当 1 个任意食物）。把鸟放到该栖息地最左侧空位，每栖息地最多 5 只。然后可选择触发该鸟的<when_played_power>。打鸟不激活该行棕色能力。
description.en: Choose 1 <bird_card> from hand, decide the habitat (<forest_habitat>/<grassland_habitat>/<wetland_habitat>, choose one if the card has multiple) and column (column 1 has no egg cost; columns 2–3 cost 1 egg; columns 4–5 cost 2 eggs). Pay the food cost using food from <player_food_supply> only (<wild_food> counts as any one food; while playing a bird, 2 any food may count as 1 any food). Place the bird in the leftmost empty space of that habitat; each habitat holds at most 5 birds. Then you may trigger the bird's <when_played_power>. Playing a bird does not activate brown powers.

triggers.target: 1 张手牌中的 <bird_card>，以及要放入的 <forest_habitat>/<grassland_habitat>/<wetland_habitat> 与列（1–5）

description.zh: 支付目标列的蛋费（第 1 列 0 蛋，第 2–3 列 1 蛋，第 4–5 列 2 蛋）与该鸟的食物费。
description.en: Pay the egg cost of the target column (0 for column 1, 1 for columns 2–3, 2 for columns 4–5) and the bird's food cost.

<ontology::transfer>.quantity: 目标列对应的蛋费（第 1 列 0；第 2–3 列 1；第 4–5 列 2）
该鸟牌的食物费用（<wild_food> 可当任意一种；打鸟时 2 个任意食物可当 1 个任意食物）

description.zh: 把鸟牌从手牌放到目标栖息地最左侧空位。
description.en: Move the bird card from hand to the leftmost empty space of the target habitat.

description.zh: 不触发
description.en: Do not trigger

description.zh: 可选：结算刚打出鸟的<when_played_power>。
description.en: Optionally resolve the played bird's <when_played_power>.

description.zh: 在玩家板获取食物行最左侧未使用的格子放一个<action_cube>，获得该格收益。从<birdfeeder>的骰子一颗一颗获得食物：每颗骰子给 1 个对应类型<food>（若骰面是野生图标则自选任意一种）。管理骰塔：托盘空时把 5 颗骰全部抛回；若剩余骰子全部同一面（含只剩 1 颗），可在获得食物前选择全部重掷。若该格有 card-to-food 转换，可弃最多 1 张手牌额外得 1 食物。然后从右到左触发<forest_habitat>中所有鸟的<when_activated_power>（全部可选）。
description.en: Place an <action_cube> on the leftmost unused space of the gain food row and gain its reward. Gain food from the <birdfeeder> one die at a time: each die gives 1 food of the shown type (wild icon = any one food). Manage the feeder: if the tray is empty, throw all 5 dice back; if all remaining dice show the same face (even one die), you may reroll all 5 before gaining food. If the space has a card-to-food conversion, you may discard up to 1 hand card to gain 1 extra food. Then activate brown <when_activated_power>s in <forest_habitat> from right to left, all optional.

triggers.target: 玩家板获取食物行最左侧未使用的格

description.zh: 把 1 个<action_cube>放在获取食物行最左侧未使用的格，获得该格印的食物数量。
description.en: Place 1 <action_cube> on the leftmost unused gain food space and gain the printed number of food.

description.zh: 从<birdfeeder>逐颗取骰结算：每颗骰得 1 个对应类型食物；可先按骰塔规则决定是否重掷全部 5 颗。
description.en: Take dice from the birdfeeder one at a time; each die gives 1 food of its type; apply the reroll rules first if desired.

description.zh: 不换
description.en: Do not convert

name.zh: 弃 1 张手牌得 1 食物

description.zh: 若该格有 card-to-food 转换：弃最多 1 张手牌，从<birdfeeder>剩余骰中选 1 颗得 1 个对应食物。
description.en: If the space has card-to-food: discard up to 1 hand card, choose 1 remaining die in the feeder, and gain 1 matching food.

description.zh: 从右到左结算<forest_habitat>中每只鸟的<when_activated_power>；每项均可选。
description.en: Resolve each <when_activated_power> in <forest_habitat> from right to left; each is optional.

description.zh: 在玩家板下蛋行最左侧未使用的格子放一个<action_cube>，获得该格数量的<egg>。蛋从<ontology::supply>放到鸟牌上，颜色无关；每只鸟有蛋上限，超过上限的蛋浪费。若该格有 food-to-egg 转换，可最多付 1 个食物额外下 1 颗蛋。然后从右到左触发<grassland_habitat>中所有鸟的<when_activated_power>（全部可选）。
description.en: Place an <action_cube> on the leftmost unused lay eggs space and gain that many <egg>s from supply onto birds; color does not matter; each bird has an egg capacity, excess eggs are lost. If the space has food-to-egg, you may spend up to 1 food to lay 1 extra egg. Then activate brown <when_activated_power>s in <grassland_habitat> from right to left, all optional.

triggers.target: 玩家板下蛋行最左侧未使用的格

description.zh: 把 1 个<action_cube>放在下蛋行最左侧未使用的格，获得该格印的蛋数量。
description.en: Place 1 <action_cube> on the leftmost unused lay eggs space and gain the printed number of eggs.

description.zh: 从<ontology::supply>取得该数量<egg>，任意分配到自己的鸟牌上（可集中），每只鸟不能超过蛋上限。
description.en: Take that many <egg>s from supply and place them on your birds (distribution is free), never exceeding each bird's egg capacity.

description.zh: 不换
description.en: Do not convert

description.zh: 若该格有 food-to-egg 转换：最多付 1 个<food>，额外下 1 颗蛋。
description.en: If the space has food-to-egg: spend up to 1 <food> to lay 1 extra egg.

description.zh: 从右到左结算<grassland_habitat>中每只鸟的<when_activated_power>；每项均可选。
description.en: Resolve each <when_activated_power> in <grassland_habitat> from right to left; each is optional.

description.zh: 在玩家板抽牌行最左侧未使用的格子放一个<action_cube>，获得该格数量的<bird_card>。可逐张从<bird_tray>的 3 张正面朝上牌或<bird_deck>顶选择；无手牌上限。若该格有 egg-to-card 转换，可从自己鸟牌上弃最多 1 颗<egg>多抽 1 张。抽走的正面朝上牌不立即补，回合末补。然后从右到左触发<wetland_habitat>中所有鸟的<when_activated_power>（全部可选）。
description.en: Place an <action_cube> on the leftmost unused draw cards space and gain that many <bird_card>s. Draw each card from the <bird_tray> (3 face-up) or the top of <bird_deck>; no hand limit. If the space has egg-to-card, you may discard up to 1 <egg> from your birds to draw 1 extra card. Face-up cards are not refilled immediately; refill at round end. Then activate brown <when_activated_power>s in <wetland_habitat> from right to left, all optional.

triggers.target: 玩家板抽牌行最左侧未使用的格

description.zh: 把 1 个<action_cube>放在抽牌行最左侧未使用的格，获得该格印的抽牌数量。
description.en: Place 1 <action_cube> on the leftmost unused draw cards space and gain the printed number of card draws.

description.zh: 逐张从<bird_tray>或<bird_deck>顶抽牌，可先看再决定后续来源。
description.en: Draw each card from the <bird_tray> or the top of <bird_deck>; after seeing a card you may choose the next source.

description.zh: 不换
description.en: Do not convert

description.zh: 若该格有 egg-to-card 转换：从自己鸟牌上移除最多 1 颗<egg>放回供应，多抽 1 张鸟牌。
description.en: If the space has egg-to-card: remove up to 1 <egg> from your birds to the supply and draw 1 extra bird card.

description.zh: 从右到左结算<wetland_habitat>中每只鸟的<when_activated_power>；每项均可选。
description.en: Resolve each <when_activated_power> in <wetland_habitat> from right to left; each is optional.

description.zh: 回合末把<bird_tray>上所有正面朝上的<bird_card>弃到<bird_discard_pile>，再从<bird_deck>顶补 3 张正面朝上。若牌库抽空，把弃牌堆洗成新牌库。
description.en: At round end discard all face-up <bird_card>s from the <bird_tray> to <bird_discard_pile>, then draw 3 new ones face up from <bird_deck>. If the deck is empty, shuffle the discard pile into a new deck.

description.zh: 按<goal_board>当前面结算本回合的目标。绿色面按目标项数量排名给第 1/2/3 名分数，平局合并名次并向下取整；蓝色面每有 1 个目标项得 1 分，上限 5 分。每位玩家都必须在目标板上放一个<action_cube>标记得分（包括 0 分）。
description.en: Score this round's goal according to the active side of the <goal_board>. Green side ranks the targeted item count and awards 1st/2nd/3rd; ties combine places and round down. Blue side scores 1 point per targeted item, max 5. Every player places an <action_cube> on the goal board to mark their score (including 0).

description.zh: 把本回合目标得分记录到<goal_board>。
description.en: Record this round's goal score on the <goal_board>.

description.zh: 每回合结束后把<first_player_marker>按顺时针交给下一位玩家。
description.en: At the end of each round, pass the <first_player_marker> clockwise to the next player.

description.zh: 终局比较总分：鸟牌分值 + 奖励牌分值 + 回合末目标得分 + 鸟蛋 1 分/颗 + 缓存食物 1 分/个 + 塞入牌 1 分/张。总分最高者获胜；平局比较玩家板旁剩余<food>数量，最多者获胜；仍平局共享胜利。
description.en: At game end compare total score: bird VP + bonus cards + end-of-round goals + eggs 1 VP each + cached food 1 VP each + tucked cards 1 VP each. Highest total wins; ties are broken by most food beside the mat; if still tied, players share the victory.

description.zh: 按总分→剩余食物数→共享胜利的顺序判定胜者。
description.en: Determine the winner by total score, then food remaining, then shared victory.

description.zh: 每张正面朝上的<bird_card>按牌面印的分值计分。
description.en: 每张正面朝上的<bird_card>按牌面印的分值计分。

description.zh: 每张正面朝上的<bird_card>按牌面印的分值计分。
description.en: 每张正面朝上的<bird_card>按牌面印的分值计分。

description.zh: 按每张<bonus_card>上印的计分条件结算。
description.en: 按每张<bonus_card>上印的计分条件结算。

description.zh: 按每张<bonus_card>上印的计分条件结算。
description.en: 按每张<bonus_card>上印的计分条件结算。

description.zh: 把四回合在<goal_board>上获得的目标得分相加。
description.en: 把四回合在<goal_board>上获得的目标得分相加。

description.zh: 把四回合在<goal_board>上获得的目标得分相加。
description.en: 把四回合在<goal_board>上获得的目标得分相加。

description.zh: 玩家板鸟牌上每颗<egg>得 1 分。
description.en: 玩家板鸟牌上每颗<egg>得 1 分。

description.zh: 玩家板鸟牌上每颗<egg>得 1 分。
description.en: 玩家板鸟牌上每颗<egg>得 1 分。

description.zh: 鸟牌上每个<cached_food>得 1 分。
description.en: 鸟牌上每个<cached_food>得 1 分。

description.zh: 鸟牌上每个<cached_food>得 1 分。
description.en: 鸟牌上每个<cached_food>得 1 分。

description.zh: 鸟牌下每张<tucked_cards>中的鸟牌得 1 分。
description.en: 鸟牌下每张<tucked_cards>中的鸟牌得 1 分。

description.zh: 鸟牌下每张<tucked_cards>中的鸟牌得 1 分。
description.en: 鸟牌下每张<tucked_cards>中的鸟牌得 1 分。
